Builddrone 0.5.3 is a security release. It closes a remaining intermediate-path
symlink bypass in `filesystem.cleanup` that could delete host or CI files and
directories outside the workspace.

**Documentation:** https://nepitwin.github.io/Buildrone/latest/

---

## Security fixes

### Filesystem cleanup symlink-component rejection

`filesystem.cleanup` now rejects listed `files` and `folders` whose path
components under the workspace base include a symlink before `os.remove` or
`shutil.rmtree`.

This prevents a contributor from planting a directory symlink at an expected
prefix such as `result` in `result/summary.txt` or `result/cache` so that
cleanup follows the link and permanently deletes regular files or folders on
the host. Top-level folder symlinks were already refused by `rmtree`; nested
paths were not.

This matches the full-path symlink-component rejection introduced for
`filesystem.copy`, `archiver`, and the upload modules in 0.5.2.
